data.name: STRIKEM
data.detailed_description:
STRIKEM

A fast, physics-driven 2D platform shooter where momentum is everything. Slide down slopes, ride the recoil, and out-maneuver your enemies across tight, hand-built arenas. Every shot is server-authoritative, so fights come down to skill — not who's running hacks.

Jump in from anywhere. STRIKEM runs on PC, in your browser, and on mobile from a single account — your progress, rank, and loadouts follow you everywhere.

Game Modes

  • Team Deathmatch — classic loadout-based team combat.

  • Free-For-All — every player for themselves in a teamless frag race.

  • Capture the Flag — grab, carry, and defend in objective-based team play.

  • King of the Hill — contest and hold the zone to win.

  • Coin Confirmed — kills drop bounty coins; grab them before the enemy does.

Team Up — PvE

  • Zombie Survival — hold out against escalating waves, crack reward chests for ammo, weapons, and overshields, and see how long your squad lasts.

  • Campaign: Iron Directive — a co-op mission campaign across multiple worlds, playable solo or with a friend. Fight through objectives, in-engine cutscenes, and a reactor-core finale.

Progress & Loadout

  • 108 ranks of XP progression, global leaderboards, and career achievements.

  • In-match medals and daily & weekly challenges that reward you for playing your way.

  • Killstreaks — chain kills into recon sweeps, resupplies, overshields, and airstrikes.

  • Character customization — mix and match modular gear to build your look.

  • Weapon skins & flair — camo, gold, and diamond gun skins, name colors, kill-feed banners, emotes, and sprays.

Squad Up

  • Friends & parties — team up and queue together on the same side.

  • Clans — pool XP, level up your clan, and design your own emblem.

  • Custom matches — pick the map, mode, and bots, then invite your crew.

  • Global chat — talk to everyone in the lobby between matches.

Solo-Friendly

Not in the mood for humans? Fill any mode with AI bots across Easy, Normal, and Hard, run the campaign solo, or warm up in a Training Brawl. New players get eased in with guided onboarding.

Extras

  • Match replays & Theater — rewatch any match with free-cam, follow, and scrub controls.

  • Kill cam — see exactly how you went down.

STRIKEM is in active development — new modes, maps, and features land regularly. Jump in, climb the ranks, and help shape where it goes.

data.short_description: Fast, physics-driven 2D platform shooter built for chaos. Battle across Team Deathmatch, CTF, Free-For-All, King of the Hill & Coin Confirmed, survive co-op Zombie waves and the Iron Directive campaign, then grind 108 ranks of loot. Squad up with friends or drop in solo vs AI.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz (Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated with WebGL 2.0 (Intel HD 4000 / equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz (Core i5 / Ryzen 5)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any dedicated GPU or modern integrated (Intel Iris Xe / Vega)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated with WebGL 2.0 (Intel Iris / Apple GPU)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or later
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon GPU or dedicated
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
